description: BIM Earth Consultancy provided comprehensive BIM services for the NCRTC Delhi–Ghaziabad–Meerut Corridor for Datamatics India. The scope of work included BIM model development, Revit family creation, multidisciplinary coordination, clash detection, and asset management. BIM Earth Consultancy supported the project from the Detailed Design stage through the As-Built stage, ensuring accurate, coordinated, and updated BIM information throughout the project lifecycle. These services helped enhance design coordination, identify and resolve clashes, and establish reliable asset information for project handover and future facility management.
scope: Development and updating of BIM models in accordance with project requirements
Creation and placement of project-specific Revit families
Multidisciplinary BIM coordination and model integration
Identification and management of design conflicts through clash detection
Coordination and resolution of clashes between different disciplines and systems
Updating BIM models based on design revisions and site requirements
Development and maintenance of models from Detailed Design to As-Built stage
Incorporation of relevant asset information into the BIM environment
Asset management and structured information development for project handover
highlight: Supported the project from Detailed Design to As-Built stage, with reliable asset information delivered for handover and facility management.
